message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. The white background is bordered on the left and bottom by thick red bands. At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is centered. Above it, grey text reads "ALIRAN FULUS LABORA SITORUS" on the left and "DI BALIK KECELAKAAN ANAK AHMAD DHANI" on the right. Below the main title, smaller grey text says "EDISI 16-22 SEPTEMBER 2013."

Dominating the left is large black text: "Halo, Saya Bunda Putri." Smaller grey text below reads: "Orang kuat di Kementerian Pertanian ini disebut-sebut ikut memuluskan korupsi daging."

To the right, a caricature of a person with short black hair and glasses wears a blue suit and heels, carrying a red handbag. This figure is entangled in a long green ribbon while stepping across a large, yellow, scalloped emblem on the ground. The emblem features red concentric circles and a stylized green plant motif. A barcode and price information, "RP 33.000," are at the bottom left. A long shadow stretches from the emblem toward the bottom right.
